Share (0-1) of valid votes won by left / centre-left parties in the latest national (parliamentary / presidential) election available for the area. Local columns carry the election year (elec_national_<year>_left_share); the global name always holds the latest year.
Share (0-1) of valid votes won by right / centre-right parties in the latest national (parliamentary / presidential) election available for the area.
Share (0-1) of valid votes won by all other parties in the latest national (parliamentary / presidential) election available for the area.

Voter turnout of the latest national election available for the area: ballots cast divided by eligible / registered voters (electors), a 0-1 fraction shown as %. Local columns carry the election year (elec_national_<year>_turnout_rate); the global name holds the latest year. Empty where the source publishes no elector counts (e.g. Ontario provincial elections). Resampled as a mean weighted by population (a proxy for electors).
Total votes cast in the latest national (parliamentary / presidential) election available for the area.

Share (0-1) of dwellings built before 1945. Aggregated from each source's own construction-period bands by `pycensus.year_built` (uniform distribution of the dwellings over the years of each band, bin edges 1945 / 1970 / 2000, bins [..1944], [1945..1969], [1970..1999], [2000..]; a band straddling an edge is split pro rata to its years, e.g. US ACS 1940-49 is split 50/50 at 1945, Germany 1919-48 26/30 before 1945, Spain 1961-70 9/10 before 1970; open-ended oldest bands are assumed to start in 1900). Dwellings of unknown year are excluded from the denominator. Native level and band source per country: US ACS5 B25034 (tract/block group, dwellings); Spain Census 2021 year-built groups (district-native, dwellings; Catastro buildings as fallback, section-native, buildings); Germany Zensus 2022 100 m grid 'Gebaeude nach Baujahr' (buildings, bands 1919/1948/1978/1990/2000/2010/2019); Canada StatCan 2021 period of construction (dissemination area / Toronto neighbourhood, occupied private dwellings, bands <=1960/1961-80/-90/-2000/..). Not available: Mexico, Chile, Israel, Taiwan, Andorra, Euskadi (mean age only).

Number of dwellings (occupied or not).

Mean one-way commute time of workers, minutes.
Mean one-way commute time of the workers who live in the area (by home), minutes; workers at home excluded.
Mean one-way commute time of the people who work in the area (by workplace), minutes.

Mean transit level of service of the places where the workers who live in the area work (by home): the level of service of each destination block group (population-weighted mean of its cells) averaged over the home-to-work commuting flows (LODES), weighted by workers.

Mean transit level of service of the places where the people who work in the area live (by workplace): the level of service of each origin block group (population-weighted mean of its cells) averaged over the home-to-work commuting flows (LODES), weighted by workers.
